description: Header file defining callback wrapper classes for Android sensor HAL interfaces, supporting V2.0 and V2.1 versions, with methods for sensor connection/disconnection and event posting.

classes.name: IHalProxyCallbackWrapperBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for sensor HAL callback wrappers supporting sensor connection/disconnection and event posting.

classes.name: HalProxyCallbackWrapperBase
classes.description: Template base class implementing common callback wrapper functionality for specific callback types.

classes.name: HalProxyCallbackWrapperV2_0
classes.description: Callback wrapper for V2.0 sensor HAL interface, converting and forwarding sensor connection events and posted events.

classes.name: HalProxyCallbackWrapperV2_1
classes.description: Callback wrapper for V2.1 sensor HAL interface, forwarding sensor connection events and posted events.

methods.name: onDynamicSensorsConnected
methods.description: Handles dynamic sensor connection events, converting data for V2.0 or V2.1 as needed.

methods.name: postEvents
methods.description: Posts sensor events, with conversion for V2.0 interface.

methods.name: createScopedWakelock
methods.description: Creates a wakelock object to manage power during sensor event processing.
